scope.question: 在来源题首答、重答、一般历史、题号与帮助数量之外，错误首答来源中的帮助次序是否增加下一题记录首答的预测信息？
scope.data: ASSISTments 2012–13；回顾性、按学生固定切分的记录前缀预测
scope.source_target: 原完整日志中相邻、同一单标签、不同题号的主问题；来源安全完成且end严格早于target.start；目标日志首答前无记录帮助
scope.conditions: 目标是否求助是实际路径限定，不是开始题目时已知条件；未记录帮助不等于排除日志外帮助。不同题号不保证内容不同。严格邻接排除另起scaffold日志的路径。
scope.inference: 条件预测，不估计帮助的因果教学率、潜在掌握或任务选择收益。ASSIST09已结束的试探保持原结论。
scope.primary: student-weighted log loss Porder-Pany; added location contrasts only for source first-answer wrong; negative favors Porder
scope.result_reading: Pany相对P0的帮助信息增量在两种权重下区间均低于零；Porder相对Pany的学生等权主差值极小且区间跨零，事件权区间不跨零。两种视角都保留。

sample.split: SHA256(UTF8('repa-help-sequence-v1:'+original user_id)) first8bytes big-endian %100；0–69 train，70–84 validation，85–99 test
sample.filter_counting: condition_pass_*是可排序用户原相邻边中每项条件的独立通过数；cumulative_pass_*按下列顺序累计。safe_failure_*可重叠，不可相加作为互斥排除数。
sample.support_counting: 分组events是记录数量，students是各组不同学生数；同一学生可属于多个组。test支持表来自任务与来源历史，不用于候选选择。
sample.time: 无时区日期保持naive日历坐标，不声称统一UTC。任何坏start或混合时间轴使整用户不可排序；同start组成员不能作为本次source/target，不删除行桥接。

preparation_method.current_target: only targets file y; source_y and earlier released history may contain past labels
preparation_method.history_release: safe completed main records end strictly before target.start; subtract current source from count/success/anyHelp; ties allowed only as earlier aggregate history
preparation_method.target_future_filter: no target end, post-answer timing anomaly, or completion filtering
preparation_method.vocabulary_or_scaler: not built by prepare; fitter train-only
preparation_method.missing_identifiers: same-template/assistment requires exact equal strings and nonempty string; raw identifiers otherwise preserved

prior_training_structure.scope: 可排序训练用户的完整原日志相邻边（包括tie或重叠）；来源nScaffolds>0。它是原训练结构范围，不是最终预测cohort，也不证明scaffold由前一主问题触发。

models.family: 学生等权L2正则logistic；每位训练学生的事件权重总和相同、全部权重总和1；截距不惩罚。

P0.definition: 来源首答、重答数量、来源时长与间隔、排除本次来源后的安全完成历史、题号已见及同模板/容器

Porder.definition: Pany + preOnly×(1−source_y)、both×(1−source_y)；postOnly为有帮助位置参照，首答正确层新增列恒零

models.transform: 均值/总体标准差、类别词表只取训练候选；source/target problem训练频数<20归OOV，其他类别保留训练值，未知归OOV；稀疏one-hot不缩放。三个模型公共列变换一致。
models.selection: validation student-equal log loss; exact tie chooses larger lambda

numerical_solver.method: L-BFGS-B；β=Dθ，调用原β目标与ridge，最后按原β梯度接受

numerical_validation.all_12_diagnostic_thresholds_and_lambda_: passed; all stored original betas independently recomputed on train
numerical_validation.acceptance_coordinates: original beta; optimizer theta gradient never substitutes
numerical_validation.scope: all 12 train original-beta objectives/gradients independently recomputed; selected 3 validation metrics/test logits independently recomputed; no test outcome evaluation

test.scope: fixed student split; retrospective completed-source prediction evaluated on the observed path with no logged pre-answer target help; no causal treatment or mastery inference
test.primary_comparison: student-weighted log loss Porder-Pany; added location contrasts only for source first-answer wrong; negative favors Porder

bootstrap.method: paired resampling of students; fixed selected coefficients and predictions; no refitting

test.calibration_weighting: student-bin means condition each student's overall 1/n_i event weight on the bin; subgroup summaries below recompute student weights within each subgroup

independent_test_validation.scope: all test aggregate model metrics, both paired differences/CIs, 12 predeclared groups and 3x10 calibration bins; fixed predictions, no refitting

weighting.subgroups: student counts recalculated within each group
weighting.calibration: condition original overall 1/n_i event weights within each bin
weighting.bootstrap: 2000 fixed-seed paired student draws, multiplicity-weighted independent reconstruction
